Subject: Redwood demo — timezone confusion

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for setting up the demo. I just pulled the calendar invite and I'm seeing two different time labels: the subject says 10:00 CET but my calendar displays 09:00 UTC. We have a couple of EU-based folks and a pair joining from the US West coast — I want to make sure nobody gets the wrong start time.

We also have one attendee (Tim Park, cloud ops) who will be traveling the morning of 17 Mar and prefers later in the day CET. Would you be able to move the session to either 14:00 CET / 13:00 UTC or 15:00 CET / 14:00 UTC on Tue 17 Mar if that works?

Attached our initial internal agenda (initial-MAP.pdf) so you can see the expected audience. If shifting is hard, we can try to keep the original but we need a clear timezone label on the invite (both CET and UTC would be ideal).

Thanks — Laura

--

Short answer: we can absolutely move and will make the invite labels explicit (CET / UTC). Two quick asks so we lock a time that works across regions:

- Do you prefer 14:00 CET (13:00 UTC) or 15:00 CET (14:00 UTC) on Tue 17 Mar?
- Confirm the attendee list in the attached agenda and let me know if Tim needs dial-in (he's listed as remote).

Internal note: I'm looping in Karthik and Soojin to confirm internal attendance and whether we need to route the demo to our EU-dedicated instance for lower latency.

I attached a proposed-times.ics with both options — if you confirm one I will update the calendar and include both CET and UTC in the title and description.
